# PinePods 0.9.2

A quick patch for 0.9.1. **If you're on 0.9.1, please upgrade.** Some podcasts stopped playing on every client, and this release fixes them automatically.

---

## Before you upgrade

- **The iOS app will now requires iOS 15 or later once out.**

---

## Episodes that wouldn't play

0.9.1 could save the wrong link for an episode, or no link at all, so it would fail to play. This came from a feed-parsing library update and affected podcasts whose feeds include extra media tags

- **Users subscribed to the same podcast now share one copy of its episodes.** Each feed is fetched and stored once, so adding a show another user already follows is quicker and the database no longer grows with every user. Listening progress, saved, queued and downloaded episodes stay per user.
- **Fixed:** a YouTube download limit of 0 days now keeps all videos instead of removing them; deleting a YouTube channel no longer fails on Postgres (#879).
- **Stuck uploads fixed** — a failed upload no longer l

If you're already running PinePods on Postgres 17, you **cannot** simply bump the image tag — a major Postgres version uses an incompatible on-disk format and `postgres:18` will refuse to start against an older data directory. > - focused two-connection live test passes against MySQL 8.4.10 with TLS identity disabled and a 38-character password
> MySQL documents caching_sha2_password nonces as 20 bytes. HandshakeV10 carries the second nonce segment in a 13-byte field where the final byte is the NUL separator before the plugin name. no outages last month, true, but not because there were none: the panel was
